title: Mandatory Parameterized SQLAlchemy Core Queries
content: Prohibit all Python f-string or string formatting inside SQL queries. All queries must use SQLAlchemy select() / update() construct with explicit parameter binding.

title: CI Run #89: Tenant search test suite broke due to unparameterized SQL query

content: Refactored user search filter to use SQLAlchemy select(User).where(User.username.ilike(...)) and context tenant_id. Added automated regression test.

title: CWE-89: SQL Injection in User Search Endpoint
content: Reported vulnerability where query parameters were directly formatted into raw SQL string. Resolved by PR #142 adhering to ADR-003.

content: Every database test must use the async_session fixture with transaction rollback to keep test sandboxes isolated.

title: Idempotent Webhook Processing & Async Retries
content: All external webhook consumers must store incoming idempotency event IDs in Redis with a 72‑hour TTL; background task handlers must be decorated with @idempotent_task; failed jobs must use exponential backoff with dead‑letter queue escalation.

title: Store webhook event IDs in Redis with 72‑hour TTL
content: Webhook consumers persist the idempotency event ID in Redis, expiring after 72 hours to prevent duplicate processing.

title: Decorate background task handlers with @idempotent_task
content: All async task handlers must be wrapped with the @idempotent_task decorator to enforce idempotency.

title: Use exponential backoff with dead‑letter queue escalation for failed jobs
content: Failed async jobs should retry with exponential backoff and, after a configurable number of attempts, be routed to a dead‑letter queue.

title: Tenant Isolation via Explicit Context Session
content: All database and service queries must obtain tenant_id exclusively from the cryptographically verified JWT session context (core.context.get_current_tenant_id()). Endpoints are forbidden from accepting tenant_id as a client‑controlled URL parameter or request body field. Database queries must enforce row‑level security or explicit User.tenant_id == get_current_tenant_id() filter.

title: Endpoint Tenant ID Convention
content: Endpoints must not accept tenant_id as a client‑controlled URL parameter or request body field.

title: IDOR Risk (CWE‑639)
content: Passing tenant_id via HTTP request payloads or URL parameters created severe IDOR risks and allowed users to query data from competitor organizations.

content:
# ADR-003: Mandatory Parameterized SQLAlchemy Core Queries

## Status
APPROVED (2026-07-20)

## Context
A critical vulnerability (CWE-89) was discovered in the user search filter where raw Python f-strings formatted user input into SQLite/Postgres query strings, causing CI Run #89 to fail.

## Decision
1. Never use raw string formatting (`f"SELECT ... {param}"` or `.format()`) inside any database

## Protocol for Failing Builds
1. Inspect failing test node in `tests/`.
2. Check if the failure is related to a known architectural constraint (`ADR-001` or `ADR-003`).
3. Query Cognee Memory Graph to identify similar past PRs (`PR-142`).
4. Re-run security test harness before staging merge requests.

title: File: docs/conventions/coding_standards.md
content:
# Repository Coding Standards

## 1. Async-First FastAPI Architecture
- All API route handlers must be defined as `async def`.
- Database I/O must use `AsyncSession` with `await session.execute(...)`.

## 2. Input Validation & Strict Typing
- Every endpoint payload must be typed using Pydantic V2 `BaseModel`.
- Type annotations (`mypy` strict) are required for all function arguments and returns.
